ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Get-ADDBAccount Usage
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects suspicious invocation of the Get-ADDBAccount script that reads from a ntds.dit file and may be used to get access to credentials without using any credential dumpers Note: Unmapped fields: Payload

sequences.query: (Payload = RGX(".*Get\\-ADDBAccount.*") AND Payload = RGX(".*BootKey\\ .*") AND Payload = RGX(".*DatabasePath\\ .*"))
